title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Job Title: Accounts Administrator
Location: Studley
Salary: £28,000-£32,000 per annum, depending on experience
Hours: Full-time
I'm working with an established business based in Studley who are looking to recruit an organised and hands-on Accounts Administrator to join their team.
This is a varied role offering genuine responsibility, working closely with colleagues across the business and an external accountant. You'll play an important part in keeping the day-to-day finance function running smoothly, maintaining accurate records and ensuring customer payments are followed up.
If you enjoy working in a varied finance role where you can take ownership, use your initiative and make a real contribution, this could be an excellent opportunity.
Key responsibilities:
- Processing day-to-day financial transactions accurately using Xero.
- Completing bank and account reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Monitoring outstanding customer invoices and proactively chasing overdue payments by telephone and email.
- Allocating customer payments and maintaining accurate sales ledger records.
- Reviewing aged debt reports and escalating overdue accounts where necessary.
- Processing supplier invoices, checking documentation and preparing payments.
- Allocating transactions to the correct cost centres.
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and the external accountant.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end and year-end activities.
- Assisting with compliance records, financial documentation and general accounts administration.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and support the wider business.

About you
You'll be a practical, reliable and detail-focused finance professional who enjoys taking responsibility for your work.
Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in accounts administration, accounts assistance, bookkeeping or credit control.
- Experience using Xero or another accounting package.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger, sales ledger and reconciliations.
- Confidence chasing outstanding payments and having professional conversations about money owed.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage your workload independently and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach.
- A relevant qualification such as AAT would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on offer?
- Salary of £28,000-£32,000, depending on experience.
- Full-time, permanent employment.
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and ownership.
- A supportive working environment.
- The opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to improving finance processes.

Interested?
If you're looking for a hands-on accounts role where you can make a difference and become a valued member of the team, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Warwick
£30,000
Monday to Friday, hybrid with three days in the office and two from home
Permanent

Our client is a long established and growing building services business based in Warwick, with much of its work now in the data centre sector. The office team is small, friendly and close knit, people tend to stay for many years, and everyone pulls together to help each other out.

Due to growth they are now looking for an Accounts Assistant to join the finance team. This is a new position and a varied one, covering purchase ledger, credit control and sales invoicing, along with general finance and office support. It would suit someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in accurate work and likes being part of a team where everybody mucks in.

What s on offer
- Salary of £30,000
- Hybrid working, three days in the office and two from home
- Office days are 8:30am to 4:15pm, home days are 9:00am to 5:00pm
- 25 days holiday, increasing with length of service
- An extra half day off each month on top of your holiday
- Salary sacrifice pension, with employer contributions increasing with length of service
- Annual BUPA health assessment
- Death in service cover of five times salary
- Free parking on site

The role

Purchase ledger
- Enter purchase invoices and credit notes onto Sage, coding them accurately to the correct nominal codes
- Check and chase outstanding purchase orders each day
- Follow the approval process for purchases and keep records filed correctly
- Process supplier remittances every two weeks
- Make small payments by bank transfer and company credit card

Credit control
- Keep the debtor records up to date
- Contact customers by phone and email to keep on top of outstanding payments
- Help with enquiries coming into the accounts inbox

Sales invoicing
- Raise detailed sales invoices, starting with breakdown work and building up to other types of work
- Work with the operations team on invoice forecasting and job costing
- Maintain delivery note records
- Complete monthly reconciliations and invoicing linked to industry regulations

Office support
- Answer the phone and provide switchboard cover
- Open and distribute the post
- Keep filing and archiving up to date

About you

You will ideally have:
- Experience in an accounts role such as Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Finance Assistant or Credit Controller
- Experience of processing a good volume of purchase invoices
- Experience of Sage 50 Accounts or a similar accounts system
- The confidence to pick up the phone to customers about payments
- A working knowledge of Excel, including simple formulas
- Strong attention to detail and an organised approach
- A friendly, supportive nature and a willingness to help colleagues when the team is busy

Two lively dogs are in the office most days, and a cat visits now and then. You must be comfortable working around animals.

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply with your CV today.

Brellis Recruitment is acting as an employment agency for this vacancy.
